evidence: The GST ﬁlms were deposited at a substrate temperature of 90 /C176C. The substrates were 5/C25c m2 pieces of silicon with either 30 nm SiO x; 40 nm TiN on 30 nm SiO x, or 40 nm SiN x on top. The ﬁlms were grown in a ﬂow type F120 ALD reactor (ASM Microchemistry) operated at a pressure of about 10 mbar.
